decision.reason: The release note and PR [ev-7a3fdefaaff7][ev-48e334033ca5] say only that the service account template now handles annotations with boolean values. The changed-files list [ev-f84c42c2ec43] shows the fix was in deploy/charts/cert-manager/templates/serviceaccount.yaml. No upstream text names the values key that feeds those annotations. The values validator is inconclusive: serviceAccount.annotations is not in the chart's default values, and only its parent section is. A behavior-changed fix to the template is plausible, but confirming the subject path needs the PR diff or the chart's values documentation naming the key.
